paper_title: New ALPS Results on Hidden-Sector Lightweights
coupling_convention: g_agamma (pseudoscalar g-) in GeV^-1, derived from the quoted 95% CL conversion-probability limit P=2.25e-25 via Eq.(5) with B=5 T, l=4.3 m, omega=2.33 eV; higher-mass points estimated from Fig. 4 shape and gas-run limits
notes: ALPS (2010) LSW experiment at DESY. Paper reports 95% CL limits on photon-WISP-photon conversion probability (Table 1: 2.25e-25 for pseudoscalar vacuum run, 10.8e-25 for gas run) rather than tabulated coupling values. The flat low-mass limit g- ~ 6.5e-8 GeV^-1 was computed analytically from P_single = sqrt(2.25e-25) = (g*B*l/2)^2 with B*l = 21.3 GeV; the rise and gap coverage near m ~ 1.2e-3 eV (first coherence node, filled by Ar gas run with n-1 = 5e-8) are approximate reads of Fig. 4. Paper also constrains scalar ALPs (g+), hidden photons (chi vs m_gamma', best lab bound near meV, excluding chi ~ 1e-6 except tiny gap at 0.18 meV), and minicharged particles; only the pseudoscalar ALP-photon result is extracted per the hint.
